candidate_axiom.name: Quinean Naturalized Epistemology & Web of Belief
candidate_axiom.statement: No single empirical simulation failure refutes an axiom in isolation; verification recalibrates the entire interdependent web of invariants, shielding axiomatic core principles before modifying peripheral boundary conditions.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Core systemic axioms may not be discarded due to peripheral test harness failures without exhaustive boundary audit.

metadata.source_principle: Holism and Underdetermination of Theory by Data

                                           │

Core-Periphery Radial Classifier.role: Assigns epistemic centrality scores to all active architectural invariants.
Core-Periphery Radial Classifier.invariant_rule: Fundamental compositional rules receive maximum protection.

Web Recalibration Solver.role: Finds the minimal modification to the overall invariant web that resolves contradictions.
Web Recalibration Solver.invariant_rule: Maximizes conservative preservation of existing verified beliefs.

Boundary Condition Tuner.role: Adjusts peripheral interface assumptions before considering core invariant deprecation.
Boundary Condition Tuner.invariant_rule: Shields foundation axioms from noisy localized test anomalies.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Stabilizes research progress against spurious test fluctuations (+0.0110).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Quickly identifies whether failures are fundamental or superficial (+0.0150).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Protects foundational structural gains from regression (+0.0170).

tradeoffs.strengths: Prevents catastrophic discarding of good foundational ideas due to minor bugs.
tradeoffs.constraints: May tolerate flawed core ideas longer if periphery is continually adjusted.

leaderboard.name: Whiteheadian Process Philosophy & Actual Occasions
leaderboard.statement: Systems are fundamentally composed of transient temporal events (actual occasions) rather than static substances; state persistence is an emergent trajectory of serial concrescence.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Static state objects without discrete event lineage or explicit prehension transitions are prohibited.
leaderboard.principle: Concrescence of Actual Entities and Prehensive Unification

system_profile.archetype: Epochal Concrescence Engine & Event Process Graph
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Past Actual Occasions] ──(Prehension)──> [Concrescence Ingest]
                                                    │
                                                    ▼
                                    [Novel Event Integration]
                                                    │
                                                    ▼
                                    [Objectified New Occasion] ──> [Next Horizon]

Prehension Collector.role: Gathers causal effects from completed historical occasions.
Prehension Collector.invariant_rule: Must respect partial ordering of the causal spacetime graph.

Concrescence Engine.role: Fuses multiple historical influences into a singular atomic event.
Concrescence Engine.invariant_rule: Atomic occasions execute with total indivisibility.

Process Horizon Emitter.role: Objectifies new occasions into immutable historical anchors for future processes.
Process Horizon Emitter.invariant_rule: Completed occasions can never be altered or retroactively erased.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Encourages pure event-sourced and stream-processing paradigms (+0.0150).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Enables completely decoupled, asynchronous state evolution (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces highly concurrent, race-condition-free structural systems (+0.0160).

tradeoffs.strengths: Immune to race conditions and mutable state locking; natural event sourcing.
tradeoffs.constraints: High event volume requires efficient log compaction and snapshotting.

leaderboard.name: Carnapian Logical Syntax & Tolerance Principle
leaderboard.statement: The compiler must not impose a single universal meta-logic; system components may define arbitrary internal logical calculi as long as their transformation rules into boundary syntaxes are fully formalized.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Dogmatic rejection of alternative DSLs or component type systems without formal translation analysis is prohibited.
leaderboard.domain: Logical Positivism & Syntax of Language (Rudolf Carnap)
leaderboard.principle: Principle of Tolerance in Formal Languages

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Component Dialect L_A] ──┐
                             ├──> [Formal Syntax Transformation Engine] ──> [Boundary Standard]
[Component Dialect L_B] ──┘

Syntax Specification Ingest.role: Accepts arbitrary context-free or dependent formal grammars for submodules.
Syntax Specification Ingest.invariant_rule: Grammar transformation rules must be mathematically sound.

Syntax Translation Matrix.role: Compiles cross-language morphisms between disparate subsystem logics.
Syntax Translation Matrix.invariant_rule: Preserves operational semantics across syntactic translations.

Tolerance Verifier.role: Validates that heterogeneous logics interact through clean formal boundaries.
Tolerance Verifier.invariant_rule: Prevents logical inconsistencies from crossing module fences.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Permits extreme diversity of sub-domain specialized architectures (+0.0180).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Avoids religious syntax debates by accepting all formally translatable calculi (+0.0120).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Enables polyglot systems that use optimal paradigms per subsystem (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Allows each subsystem to use the domain language best suited to its requirements.
tradeoffs.constraints: Translation matrix introduces interface marshalling and proof checking overhead.
